title: Clopen restriction preserves canonically augmented derived completeness
statement: Fix the prime l, finite coefficient extension E, scheme T, clopen open U and normalized datum d [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion, def-sf-clopen-restriction-data]. For every completed-coefficient derived object M, if M is derived complete in the published canonically augmented quotient-tower sense [def-weil-derived-complete, def-weil-integral-reduction-tower, def-weil-derived-limit], its image under sfClopenDerivedRestriction d is derived complete on U. This is a preservation property only: no coefficient, chain quotient or tower isomorphisms are returned.

source.place: Tag 08TC, definition-derived-limit; canonically augmented Roos completeness paragraph of lem-sf-clopen-derived-compatibility.

proof.text: Choose the K-flat resolution and canonical augmented Roos triangle from the completeness witness. The Bool-indexed partition U and its open complement, together with the finite-clopen tensor calculus, gives K-flatness of the ordinary restricted complex. Transport scalars along the specified completed coefficient isomorphism to obtain K-flatness over the local ring. Ordinary module restriction is a right adjoint and preserves countable products. Exact countable products in both pro-etale module categories imply product preservation by the induced exact derived functor, using complex representatives and localization. The scalar-quotient comparison commutes with consecutive transitions and canonical units by its pure-tensor formula and the coefficient transition square. Assemble these comparisons into an isomorphism of augmented towers. Map the global distinguished Roos triangle through the triangulated restriction functor. Its image product, with projections composed with the tower comparisons, is a product for the local tower. Identify it with the chosen local product; projectionwise calculation identifies the second arrow with the local Roos endomorphism and the first arrow with the canonical augmentation. Transport the third arrow through the product and shift comparisons. Use the identity resolution of the restricted K-flat complex to give a local completeness witness with the same auxiliary finite-field datum. The construction also applies to empty components.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08TC; normalized scalar-quotient comparison and the canonical augmented Roos construction. Implemented by private product, K-flatness, tower, and triangle transport lemmas in the assigned module.

lean.statement:
theorem sf_clopen_preserves_completeness
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (T : Scheme.{t}) (U : T.Opens)
    (hU : IsClosed (U : Set T)) (d : SfClopenCoefficientRestriction l E T U) :
    ∀ M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E T),
    IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted l E T M →
      IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted l E U.toScheme ((sfClopenDerivedRestriction d).obj M)
